caption.text:
Wow! Swindon Town manager Ian Holloway works himself into an apoplectic rage talking to the media after their 3-1 home win to Barrow, speaking about captain Ollie Clarke appearing in their cup win over Luton while suspended due to an admin mixup.

This is quite the rant, makes Kevin Keegan’s rant seem mild by comparison…. Holloway is a footballing treasure and must be protected at all costs.

“SORT YOUR LIVES OUT, EVERY SINGLE STINKING ONE OF YOU” 😡🤬😳
